scope: All 64 named-land routes assigned to Oceania at approved geographic version3; no regional interior audit

method.source_vintage: 2017-06-15 release; underlying WVS/WDBII various older source surveys
method.source_license: LGPLv3 or later; underlying public-domain inputs do not make this release public-domain
method.area: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic area of polygon intersections, not square degrees; no antimeridian domain crossing in these declared searches
method.lagoon_handling: Subtract direct level2 lagoon/lake children of Level1, and direct Level4 children of Level3; include Level3 island-in-lagoon when selected
method.invalid_source_policy: Exact native bytes retained; make_valid only enables comparison and cannot authorize import
method.candidate_minimum_overlap: <1% of independent polygon against every existing footprint, and no existing footprint within0.003degree corridor
coverage_limits: Comparison certifies only declared source-domain polygons in GSHHG2017, not all modern shoals/islets or2026reclaimed land.
GSHHG atoll source geometry can include generalized lagoon/reef extents where no lake child exists; named-route candidates require modern coast/gazetteer cross-check before import.
All entire polygons are retained. Coordinate search domains are discovery selectors, not territorial subdivisions.
No values or identities imported; no existing footprints replaced or clipped.
No historical attributes inferred from current or2017geography.
